declarations.name: Breakdown.Coercive.Internal.DensityPassage.smooth_right_converges
declarations.type:
∀ {C : Type} (m : Breakdown.ModeWeights C) (P : ℝ) (b : Breakdown.FlowBounds C) (w : Breakdown.Space → ℝ) {k : ℕ}
  (Γ : Set Breakdown.Symmetry) (W : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space)
  (act : Fin k → ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space) {w₀ epsSup epsGradSup ratio : ℝ},
  m.IsAdmissible P b w w₀ epsSup epsGradSup ratio →
    b.IsValid m W →
      (ContDiff ℝ 2 fun z => W z.1 z.2) →
        Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic W →
          (∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space), Breakdown.divergenceAt (W σ) y = 0) →
            (∃ D, ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space), ∀ j ≤ 2, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (W σ) y‖ ≤ D / (1 + ‖y‖) ^ (j + 1)) →
              (∃ B, ∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), w y ≤ B) →
                (∀ (i : Fin k), MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => act i z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume) →
                  (∀ (i : Fin k), Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic (act i)) →
                    (∀ (i : Fin k), (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y => ‖act i σ y‖ ^ 2) < ⊤) →
                      ∀ (v : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space)
                        (G : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space)
                        (H : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space)
                        (g : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                        Breakdown.IsPerturbation Γ P v G H g →
                          ∀ (u : ℕ → ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                            Breakdown.Coercive.IsSmoothApproximation P v G H g u →
                              ∀ (κ : Fin k → ℝ) (F : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                                MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => F z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume →
                                  Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic F →
                                    (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y => ‖F σ y‖ ^ 2) < ⊤ →
                                      Breakdown.IsRightSide W act κ v G g F →
                                        ∀ (M : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                                          m.IsMultiplierField v G H M →
                                            Breakdown.Coercive.SmoothPerturbationIsPerturbationHolds →
                                              Filter.Tendsto
                                                (fun n =>
                                                  Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y =>
                                                    ‖Breakdown.Coercive.smoothRight P W (u n) σ y +
                                                            ∑ i, κ i • act i σ y -
                                                          Breakdown.Coercive.rightSideLimit W act κ v G H g σ y‖ ^
                                                      2)
                                                Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

declarations.type:
∀ {C : Type} (m : Breakdown.ModeWeights C) (P : ℝ) (b : Breakdown.FlowBounds C) (w : Breakdown.Space → ℝ) {k : ℕ}
  (Γ : Set Breakdown.Symmetry) (W : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space)
  (act : Fin k → ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space) {w₀ epsSup epsGradSup ratio : ℝ},

    b.IsValid m W →
      (ContDiff ℝ 2 fun z => W z.1 z.2) →
        Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic W →
          (∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space), Breakdown.divergenceAt (W σ) y = 0) →
            (∃ D, ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space), ∀ j ≤ 2, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (W σ) y‖ ≤ D / (1 + ‖y‖) ^ (j + 1)) →
              (∃ B, ∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), w y ≤ B) →
                (∀ (i : Fin k), MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => act i z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume) →
                  (∀ (i : Fin k), Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic (act i)) →
                    (∀ (i : Fin k), (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y => ‖act i σ y‖ ^ 2) < ⊤) →
                      ∀ (v : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space)
                        (G : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space)
                        (H : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space)
                        (g : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                        Breakdown.IsPerturbation Γ P v G H g →
                          ∀ (u : ℕ → ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                            Breakdown.Coercive.IsSmoothApproximation P v G H g u →
                              ∀ (κ : Fin k → ℝ) (F : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                                MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => F z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume →
                                  Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic F →
                                    (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y => ‖F σ y‖ ^ 2) < ⊤ →
                                      Breakdown.IsRightSide W act κ v G g F →
                                        ∀ (M : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                                          m.IsMultiplierField v G H M →
                                            Breakdown.Coercive.ModeSquareSumHolds →
                                              Breakdown.Coercive.ModeDerivativeHolds →
                                                Breakdown.Coercive.ModeRotationHolds →
                                                  Breakdown.Coercive.SmoothPerturbationIsPerturbationHolds →
                                                    ∫⁻ (σ : ℝ) in Set.Icc 0 1,
                                                          ∫⁻ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                            ∑' (ι : ℤ × ℤ),
                                                              ENNReal.ofReal
                                                                (-Breakdown.Coercive.modeRest m w W v G H ι σ y) <
                                                        ⊤ ∧
                                                      Filter.Tendsto
                                                        (fun n =>
                                                          ∫⁻ (σ : ℝ) in Set.Icc 0 1,
                                                            ∫⁻ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                              ∑' (ι : ℤ × ℤ),
                                                                ENNReal.ofReal
                                                                  (-Breakdown.Coercive.modeRest m w W (u n)
                                                                      (Breakdown.gradField (u n))
                                                                      (Breakdown.secondDerivField (u n)) ι σ y))
                                                        Filter.atTop
                                                        (nhds
                                                          (∫⁻ (σ : ℝ) in Set.Icc 0 1,
                                                            ∫⁻ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                              ∑' (ι : ℤ × ℤ),

                                                                  (-Breakdown.Coercive.modeRest m w W v G H ι σ y)))

declarations.type:

                    ∀ (t : ℝ),
                      0 < t →
                        ∀ (u : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space)
                          (Gu : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space)
                          (Hu : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space)
                          (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),

                                      Breakdown.cnormSq (Breakdown.modeVel ι u σ y - Breakdown.modeVel ι v σ y) /
                                        (1 + ‖y‖) ^ 2) +
                              ENNReal.ofReal (K * t) *

declarations.type:
∀ {C : Type} (m : Breakdown.ModeWeights C) (P : ℝ) (b : Breakdown.FlowBounds C) (w : Breakdown.Space → ℝ) {k : ℕ}
  (Γ : Set Breakdown.Symmetry) (W : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space)
  (act : Fin k → ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space) {w₀ epsSup epsGradSup ratio : ℝ},
  m.IsAdmissible P b w w₀ epsSup epsGradSup ratio →
    b.IsValid m W →
      (ContDiff ℝ 2 fun z => W z.1 z.2) →
        Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic W →
          (∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space), Breakdown.divergenceAt (W σ) y = 0) →
            (∃ D, ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space), ∀ j ≤ 2, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (W σ) y‖ ≤ D / (1 + ‖y‖) ^ (j + 1)) →
              (∃ B, ∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), w y ≤ B) →
                (∀ (i : Fin k), MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => act i z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume) →
                  (∀ (i : Fin k), Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic (act i)) →
                    (∀ (i : Fin k), (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y => ‖act i σ y‖ ^ 2) < ⊤) →
                      ∀ (v : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space)
                        (G : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space)
                        (H : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space)
                        (g : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                        Breakdown.IsPerturbation Γ P v G H g →
                          ∀ (u : ℕ → ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                            Breakdown.Coercive.IsSmoothApproximation P v G H g u →
                              ∀ (κ : Fin k → ℝ) (F : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                                MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => F z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume →
                                  Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic F →
                                    (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y => ‖F σ y‖ ^ 2) < ⊤ →
                                      Breakdown.IsRightSide W act κ v G g F →
                                        ∀ (M : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                                          m.IsMultiplierField v G H M →
                                            Breakdown.Coercive.ModeSquareSumHolds →
                                              Breakdown.Coercive.ModeDerivativeHolds →
                                                Breakdown.Coercive.ModeRotationHolds →
                                                  Breakdown.Coercive.ModeFieldExistsHolds →
                                                    Breakdown.Coercive.SolenoidalModeHolds →
                                                      Breakdown.Coercive.SmoothPerturbationIsPerturbationHolds →
                                                        ∀ (Mn : ℕ → ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                                                          (∀ (n : ℕ),
                                                              m.IsMultiplierField (u n) (Breakdown.gradField (u n))
                                                                (Breakdown.secondDerivField (u n)) (Mn n)) →
                                                            Filter.Tendsto
                                                              (fun n =>
                                                                Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y =>
                                                                  ‖Mn n σ y - M σ y‖ ^ 2)
                                                              Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

                          0) ∧

declarations.type:
∀ {C : Type} (m : Breakdown.ModeWeights C) (P : ℝ) (b : Breakdown.FlowBounds C) (w : Breakdown.Space → ℝ) {k : ℕ}
  (Γ : Set Breakdown.Symmetry) (W : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space)
  (act : Fin k → ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space) {w₀ epsSup epsGradSup ratio : ℝ},
  m.IsAdmissible P b w w₀ epsSup epsGradSup ratio →
    b.IsValid m W →
      (ContDiff ℝ 2 fun z => W z.1 z.2) →
        Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic W →
          (∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space), Breakdown.divergenceAt (W σ) y = 0) →
            (∃ D, ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space), ∀ j ≤ 2, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (W σ) y‖ ≤ D / (1 + ‖y‖) ^ (j + 1)) →
              (∃ B, ∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), w y ≤ B) →
                (∀ (i : Fin k), MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => act i z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume) →
                  (∀ (i : Fin k), Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic (act i)) →
                    (∀ (i : Fin k), (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y => ‖act i σ y‖ ^ 2) < ⊤) →
                      ∀ (v : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space)
                        (G : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space)
                        (H : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space)
                        (g : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                        Breakdown.IsPerturbation Γ P v G H g →
                          ∀ (u : ℕ → ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                            Breakdown.Coercive.IsSmoothApproximation P v G H g u →
                              ∀ (κ : Fin k → ℝ) (F : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                                MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => F z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume →
                                  Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic F →
                                    (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y => ‖F σ y‖ ^ 2) < ⊤ →
                                      Breakdown.IsRightSide W act κ v G g F →
                                        ∀ (M : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                                          m.IsMultiplierField v G H M →
                                            Breakdown.Coercive.SolenoidalModeHolds →
                                              Breakdown.periodPairing F M =
                                                Breakdown.periodPairing
                                                  (Breakdown.Coercive.rightSideLimit W act κ v G H g) M

declarations.name: Breakdown.Coercive.Internal.Absorb.pointwise
declarations.type:
∀ {C : Type} {m : Breakdown.ModeWeights C} {P : ℝ} {b : Breakdown.FlowBounds C} {w : Breakdown.Space → ℝ}
  {W : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space} {w₀ epsSup epsGradSup ratio : ℝ},
  m.IsAdmissible P b w w₀ epsSup epsGradSup ratio →
    b.IsValid m W →
      ∀ (v : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space) (G : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space)
        (H : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space) (σ : ℝ)
        (y : Breakdown.Space),
        ∑' (ι : ℤ × ℤ),
              ENNReal.ofReal
                (Breakdown.Coercive.velAmp v ι σ y ^ 2 + Breakdown.Coercive.gradAmp G ι σ y ^ 2 +
                  Breakdown.Coercive.vortGradAmp H ι σ y ^ 2) ≠
            ⊤ →
          m.densityPos P b w v G H W σ y +
              (∑' (ι : ℤ × ℤ), ENNReal.ofReal (-Breakdown.Coercive.modeRest m w W v G H ι σ y) + ENNReal.ofReal (-0) +
                ENNReal.ofReal (-Breakdown.stretchForm W v G σ y)) ≤
            ∑' (ι : ℤ × ℤ), ENNReal.ofReal (Breakdown.Coercive.modePos m P v G ι σ y) +
                    ∑' (ι : ℤ × ℤ), ENNReal.ofReal (Breakdown.Coercive.modeRest m w W v G H ι σ y) +
                  ENNReal.ofReal 0 +
                ENNReal.ofReal (Breakdown.stretchForm W v G σ y) +
              m.densityNeg P b w v G H W σ y

  0 ≤ mu →
    r ≤ perp →
      0 < s4 →
        0 ≤ mG →
          mG ≤ mGb →
            0 < eta →
              0 < etaMin →

                    0 ≤ x1 →

                                          ((1 - cμ) * mu * |dop| - mu * |rate| - mu ^ 2 * w0 ^ 2 / (4 * s4) -

                                            ((mG ^ 2 * x0 ^ 2 + (∑ α ∈ s, gW α * x0' α) ^ 2) / eta +
                                              1 / 2 * eta * mu ^ 2 * x0 ^ 2)) +
                                      ∑ α ∈ s,

declarations.type:
∀ {C : Type} (m : Breakdown.ModeWeights C) (P : ℝ) (b : Breakdown.FlowBounds C) (w : Breakdown.Space → ℝ) {k : ℕ}
  (Γ : Set Breakdown.Symmetry) (W : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space)
  (act : Fin k → ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space) {w₀ epsSup epsGradSup ratio : ℝ},
  m.IsAdmissible P b w w₀ epsSup epsGradSup ratio →
    b.IsValid m W →
      (ContDiff ℝ 2 fun z => W z.1 z.2) →
        Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic W →
          (∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space), Breakdown.divergenceAt (W σ) y = 0) →
            (∃ D, ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space), ∀ j ≤ 2, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (W σ) y‖ ≤ D / (1 + ‖y‖) ^ (j + 1)) →
              (∃ B, ∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), w y ≤ B) →
                (∀ (i : Fin k), MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => act i z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume) →
                  (∀ (i : Fin k), Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic (act i)) →
                    (∀ (i : Fin k), (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y => ‖act i σ y‖ ^ 2) < ⊤) →
                      ∀ (v : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space)
                        (G : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space)
                        (H : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space)
                        (g : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                        Breakdown.IsPerturbation Γ P v G H g →
                          ∀ (u : ℕ → ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                            Breakdown.Coercive.IsSmoothApproximation P v G H g u →
                              ∀ (κ : Fin k → ℝ) (F : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                                MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => F z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume →
                                  Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic F →
                                    (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y => ‖F σ y‖ ^ 2) < ⊤ →
                                      Breakdown.IsRightSide W act κ v G g F →
                                        ∀ (M : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                                          m.IsMultiplierField v G H M →
                                            Breakdown.Coercive.ModeSquareSumHolds →
                                              Breakdown.Coercive.ModeDerivativeHolds →
                                                Breakdown.Coercive.ModeRotationHolds →
                                                  Breakdown.Coercive.SmoothPerturbationIsPerturbationHolds →
                                                    ∀ (Mn : ℕ → ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                                                      (∀ (n : ℕ),
                                                          m.IsMultiplierField (u n) (Breakdown.gradField (u n))
                                                            (Breakdown.secondDerivField (u n)) (Mn n)) →
                                                        ∀ (n : ℕ) (M' : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                                                          m.IsMultiplierField (fun σ y => u n σ y - v σ y)
                                                              (fun σ y => Breakdown.gradField (u n) σ y - G σ y)
                                                              (fun σ y => Breakdown.secondDerivField (u n) σ y - H σ y)
                                                              M' →
                                                            (∀ (q : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → ℝ),
                                                                Breakdown.IsPeriodicTestPotential q →
                                                                  ∫ (σ : ℝ) in Set.Icc 0 1,
                                                                      ∫ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                                        inner ℝ ⋯ (Breakdown.gradientAt (q σ) y) =
                                                                    0) ∧
                                                              ∀ (ψ : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                                                                Breakdown.IsPeriodicTestField ψ →
                                                                  ∫ (σ : ℝ) in Set.Icc 0 1,
                                                                      ∫ (y : Breakdown.Space), inner ℝ ⋯ (ψ σ y) =
                                                                    0

                (∀ (c : C) (y : Breakdown.Space), |m.muW c y| ≤ B ∧ ‖y‖ ^ 2 * |m.muW c y| ≤ B) →

declarations.type:
∀ {C : Type} (m : Breakdown.ModeWeights C) (P : ℝ) (b : Breakdown.FlowBounds C) (w : Breakdown.Space → ℝ) {k : ℕ}
  (Γ : Set Breakdown.Symmetry) (W : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space)
  (act : Fin k → ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space) {w₀ epsSup epsGradSup ratio : ℝ},
  m.IsAdmissible P b w w₀ epsSup epsGradSup ratio →
    b.IsValid m W →
      (ContDiff ℝ 2 fun z => W z.1 z.2) →
        Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic W →
          (∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space), Breakdown.divergenceAt (W σ) y = 0) →
            (∃ D, ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space), ∀ j ≤ 2, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (W σ) y‖ ≤ D / (1 + ‖y‖) ^ (j + 1)) →
              (∃ B, ∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), w y ≤ B) →
                (∀ (i : Fin k), MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => act i z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume) →
                  (∀ (i : Fin k), Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic (act i)) →
                    (∀ (i : Fin k), (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y => ‖act i σ y‖ ^ 2) < ⊤) →
                      ∀ (v : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space)
                        (G : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space)
                        (H : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space)
                        (g : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                        Breakdown.IsPerturbation Γ P v G H g →
                          ∀ (u : ℕ → ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                            Breakdown.Coercive.IsSmoothApproximation P v G H g u →
                              ∀ (κ : Fin k → ℝ) (F : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                                MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => F z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume →
                                  Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic F →
                                    (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y => ‖F σ y‖ ^ 2) < ⊤ →
                                      Breakdown.IsRightSide W act κ v G g F →
                                        ∀ (M : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                                          m.IsMultiplierField v G H M →
                                            ∀ (Mn : ℕ → ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                                              (∀ (n : ℕ),
                                                  m.IsMultiplierField (u n) (Breakdown.gradField (u n))
                                                    (Breakdown.secondDerivField (u n)) (Mn n)) →
                                                Filter.Tendsto
                                                    (fun n =>
                                                      Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y => ‖Mn n σ y - M σ y‖ ^ 2)
                                                    Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
                                                  ∀ (i : Fin k),
                                                    Filter.Tendsto (fun n => Breakdown.periodPairing (act i) (Mn n))

∀ {C : Type} (m : Breakdown.ModeWeights C) (P : ℝ) (b : Breakdown.FlowBounds C) (w : Breakdown.Space → ℝ) {k : ℕ}
  (Γ : Set Breakdown.Symmetry) (W : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space)
  (act : Fin k → ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space) {w₀ epsSup epsGradSup ratio : ℝ},
  m.IsAdmissible P b w w₀ epsSup epsGradSup ratio →
    b.IsValid m W →
      (ContDiff ℝ 2 fun z => W z.1 z.2) →
        Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic W →
          (∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space), Breakdown.divergenceAt (W σ) y = 0) →
            (∃ D, ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space), ∀ j ≤ 2, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (W σ) y‖ ≤ D / (1 + ‖y‖) ^ (j + 1)) →
              (∃ B, ∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), w y ≤ B) →
                (∀ (i : Fin k), MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => act i z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume) →
                  (∀ (i : Fin k), Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic (act i)) →
                    (∀ (i : Fin k), (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y => ‖act i σ y‖ ^ 2) < ⊤) →
                      ∀ (v : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space)
                        (G : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space)
                        (H : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space)
                        (g : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                        Breakdown.IsPerturbation Γ P v G H g →
                          ∀ (u : ℕ → ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                            Breakdown.Coercive.IsSmoothApproximation P v G H g u →
                              ∀ (κ : Fin k → ℝ) (F : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                                MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => F z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume →
                                  Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic F →
                                    (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y => ‖F σ y‖ ^ 2) < ⊤ →
                                      Breakdown.IsRightSide W act κ v G g F →
                                        ∀ (M : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                                          m.IsMultiplierField v G H M →
                                            Breakdown.Coercive.SolenoidalModeHolds →
                                              Breakdown.Coercive.SmoothPerturbationIsPerturbationHolds →
                                                ∀ (Mn : ℕ → ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                                                  (∀ (n : ℕ),
                                                      m.IsMultiplierField (u n) (Breakdown.gradField (u n))
                                                        (Breakdown.secondDerivField (u n)) (Mn n)) →
                                                    Filter.Tendsto
                                                        (fun n =>
                                                          Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y => ‖Mn n σ y - M σ y‖ ^ 2)
                                                        Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
                                                      Filter.Tendsto
                                                        (fun n =>
                                                          Breakdown.periodPairing
                                                            (fun σ y =>
                                                              Breakdown.Coercive.smoothRight P W (u n) σ y +
                                                                ∑ i, κ i • act i σ y)
                                                            (Mn n))
                                                        Filter.atTop (nhds (Breakdown.periodPairing F M))

declarations.name: Breakdown.Coercive.Internal.Absorb.eps_core
declarations.type:
∀ {s : Finset (ℤ × ℤ)} {eps epsG dop r perp s1 s2 Ω mV Ωg mVG rate w0 w1 wV w2 l2 nb xc xo x1 x0 : ℝ}
  {aW gW oW hW xc' xo' x1' x0' : ℤ × ℤ → ℝ},
  0 ≤ eps →
    0 ≤ epsG →
      r ≤ perp →
        (0 < eps + epsG → 0 < s1) →
          0 < s2 →
            0 ≤ Ω →
              Ω ≤ mV →
                0 ≤ Ωg →
                  Ωg ≤ mVG →
                    0 < l2 →
                      0 ≤ xc →
                        0 ≤ xo →
                          0 ≤ x1 →
                            0 ≤ x0 →
                              xo ≤ √2 * x1 →
                                (∀ (α : ℤ × ℤ), 0 ≤ aW α) →
                                  (∀ (α : ℤ × ℤ), 0 ≤ gW α) →
                                    (∀ (α : ℤ × ℤ), 0 ≤ oW α) →
                                      (∀ (α : ℤ × ℤ), 0 ≤ hW α) →
                                        (∀ (α : ℤ × ℤ), 0 ≤ xc' α) →
                                          (∀ (α : ℤ × ℤ), 0 ≤ xo' α) →
                                            (∀ (α : ℤ × ℤ), xo' α ≤ √2 * x1' α) →
                                              ∑ α ∈ s, aW α ≤ w0 →
                                                ∑ α ∈ s, gW α ≤ w1 →
                                                  ∑ α ∈ s, oW α ≤ wV →
                                                    ∑ α ∈ s, hW α ≤ w2 →
                                                      -(s1 * Breakdown.ModeWeights.ind (0 < eps + epsG) +
                                                                        s2 * Breakdown.ModeWeights.ind (0 < nb)) *
                                                                    xc ^ 2 +
                                                                  (eps * |dop| - (eps * perp + epsG) ^ 2 / (4 * s1) -
                                                                        eps ^ 2 * w0 ^ 2 / (4 * s2) -
                                                                      eps *
                                                                        (1 / 2 * mV + |rate| + 1 / 2 * w1 + 1 / 2 * wV +
                                                                          1 / 2 * l2 * w2)) *
                                                                    xo ^ 2 -
                                                                (√2 * eps * mV + nb * (w1 + 1 / 2 * wV)) * x1 ^ 2 -
                                                              1 / 2 * nb * w2 / l2 * x0 ^ 2 -
                                                            √2 * eps * mVG * x1 * x0 +
                                                          (s2 * Breakdown.ModeWeights.ind (0 < nb) * xc ^ 2 +
                                                              nb * (w1 + 1 / 2 * wV) * x1 ^ 2 +
                                                            1 / 2 * nb * w2 / l2 * x0 ^ 2) ≤
                                                        eps * |dop| * xo ^ 2 +
                                                            (-((eps * r + epsG) * xc * xo) -
                                                                    eps * (1 / 2 * Ω + |rate|) * xo ^ 2 -
                                                                  eps * Ωg * x0 * xo -
                                                                eps * Ω * x1 * xo -
                                                              eps * xo *
                                                                ∑ α ∈ s,
                                                                  (aW α * xc' α + gW α * xo' α + hW α * x0' α +
                                                                    oW α * x1' α)) +
                                                          ∑ α ∈ s,
                                                            (s2 * (aW α / w0) * Breakdown.ModeWeights.ind (0 < eps) *
                                                                    xc' α ^ 2 +
                                                                  eps * gW α * x1' α ^ 2 +
                                                                1 / 2 * eps * oW α * x1' α ^ 2 +
                                                              1 / 2 * eps * hW α / l2 * x0' α ^ 2)
